# Vox
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to their fatal allergy to oxygen![/color]
Vox are a species of large avians that has adapted to living in low gravity environments with a complete lack of oxygen.
## Racial Features - They breathe nitrogen and [color=#ffa500] oxygen is toxic to them[/color]. - Thanks to their bio-engineered lungs, they can store up to 10L of gas inside of them to breathe. - Their blood is anaerobic and it has an opaque blue tint. - In addition to regular foods, they [color=#1e90ff]can also eat various snack packaging, banana peels, eggshells, and raw meat without any ill effects[/color]. They also like to drink welding fuel. - Their body can [color=#1e90ff]slowly heal poison damage[/color] on its own as long as it does not exceed 25 poison damage. - Their fists deal [color=red]6[/color] slash damage with unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Vod-Pidgin The Vox language, known as Vod-Pidgin, is composed of shrieks and caws. It is often described as loud and chaotic and it is quite difficult to learn for non Vox as most end up shredding their vocal chords when trying to speak it.
## Age and Names Vox, being an artificial species, are born already adults and can live anywhere from as little as a couple of years to several centuries. Their names are chosen from physical or mental features that best describe them, often being a combination of several words strung together. For those that do not speak Vod-Pidgin, these names sound like strings of sharp syllables, often starting with K, R or T.
